Strictly filter candidates to match that role. Explicitly verify that the candidate entity actually satisfies the question's primary descriptor, discarding loosely matching items, tangential examples, or literal string matches that point to the wrong subject.

Preserve necessary prefixes/modifiers exactly as used in standard reference. Prefer the exact term found in the context over synonyms or acronyms.
